title: The telomeric protein TRF2 binds the ATM kinase and can inhibit the ATM-dependent DNA damage response

grounded.context: review statement, cultured human cells after DNA damage
grounded.evidence_quote: ATM phosphorylates and stabilizes p53 in response to DNA damage (reviewed in Kastan and Lim 2000).

grounded.context: IMR90 human cells, 45 min after 20 Gy IR, review statement citing other work
grounded.evidence_quote: We also examined the phosphorylation of Nbs1 on S343, a target of ATM (Gatei et al. 2000; Lim et al. 2000; Wu et al. 2000; Zhao et al. 2000).

grounded.context: human cells overexpressing TRF2, after ionizing radiation
grounded.evidence_quote: TRF2 inhibited autophosphorylation of ATM on S1981, an early step in the activation of this kinase.

grounded.context: IMR90 primary human fibroblasts overexpressing TRF2, after irradiation
grounded.evidence_quote: Quantitative immunoblotting showed that cells overexpressing TRF2 had a diminished ability to induce p53 after irradiation (Figures 2A and 2B).

grounded.context: IMR90 primary human fibroblasts overexpressing TRF2, 45 min after 20 Gy IR
grounded.evidence_quote: In contrast, irradiation did not appear to induce phosphorylation of Nbs1 in cells overexpressing TRF2, indicating that TRF2 diminished the ATM-dependent phosphorylation of Nbs1 (Figure 2C).

grounded.context: IMR90 primary human fibroblasts overexpressing TRF2, 0-36 h after 5 Gy IR
grounded.evidence_quote: Both the relative level of p53 protein and the induction of its downstream targets p21, Bax, and Hdm2 were dampened.
